scope: Deterministic synthetic enhancement fixture at a task-local protocol-shaped waveform adapter boundary linked to one pinned source identity; no selection, superiority, real-model, device, listening, benchmark or release claim.

documented_constraints: settings.reject_unknown accepts only the model key
16 kHz or 48 kHz sessions with frames_per_call equal to rate/100
16 kHz default model fastenhancer_tiny_16k and 256-sample chunk; 48 kHz default fastenhancer_small and 512-sample chunk
wav_in and wav_out are fixed float32 [1, chunk_samples] tensors with matching cache_in_/cache_out_ tensors
nonfinite, unknown, asset-missing, shape-mismatched and dynamic-cache cases fail closed
source_identity.note: Source inspection is a boundary anchor only. No C++ stage is built, no ONNX session is created and no model weight is loaded.

frontend_contract.note: The public reference family identity and installed v0 frontend contract are preserved. Evaluation and future production callback paths are distinct; no production callback is implemented.

public_boundary.note: No public header, contract, descriptor, registry, shared build, CMake file, CI file or installed behavior is modified.

acceptance_profile.name: enhancement
mapped_cases: alignment, state, memory and timing boundary
not_applicable: unpaired-speech predictive screen or authorized listening: no licensed speech or listening result
target-device timing and memory: no exact runtime measurement
remaining_gates: held-out real paired cohort with pinned rights and clean references
independent listening or authorized predictive screen
target-device content/availability timing, memory and deadline evidence
provider intake, descriptor and catalog review
exact upstream source, model-weight and ONNX-runtime rights clearance

independent_timing_evidence.note: Preset timing values are provenance only. They are not reproduced, pooled as a controlled benchmark, assigned to this fixture or used as an acceptance threshold.

rights_gap.evidence: adapters/fastenhancer/README.md records a source release commit but no separate pretrained-model terms; weights remain local evaluation assets pending confirmation.
rights_gap.consequence: No vendoring, build, installed provider or release claim until rights are cleared.

invariants: Only this task directory is written; no shared SDK file, CMake, contract, public header, registry, default, board, handoff, CI file or installed behavior changes.
The adapter is opt-in, unregistered and disabled by default with no C provider or production callback.
All signals are frozen deterministic synthetic floats; no model, media, weight or runtime asset is read or produced.
Configuration, frame shape, finite range, epoch, position and lifecycle rejections fail closed without advancing DSP state.
Identity and noisy-input controls are reported with the candidate; regressions are recorded verbatim.
Three cold-start passes are byte-identical; canonical JSON and digest sidecars are regenerated deterministically.
Source-reported preset timing is proposal-only provenance, never a measured result, oracle or threshold.
Missing evidence never qualifies the candidate; decision remains DEFER.
blockers: No exact upstream source revision, model-weight terms or ONNX-runtime redistribution terms are cleared for packaging.
No real paired speech cohort with rights and clean references has been scored.
No independent listening or authorized predictive screen has been run.
No target-device timing, memory, pacing or deadline evidence exists for an exact runtime.
No provider intake, descriptor, catalog or default-selection review has been completed.
No exact approved external reference parity result exists.
reopening_conditions: Clear exact source, model and runtime rights and pin immutable identities before any vendoring or installed proposal.
Run a held-out real paired cohort with matched identity and noisy controls and paired SI-SDR/STOI.
Run independent listening or a separately labeled authorized predictive screen.
Measure content/availability timing, memory and deadlines on the exact target runtime.
Complete provider intake and explicit default-selection review before any registry or catalog change.
Demonstrate exact approved external reference parity without changing public family identity or frontend contracts.
